portfolio_rule: Each shared V11 monthly signal, rank four banks by the 50/50 average of frozen V34 factor rank and 60-session adjusted-close momentum rank, select the best combined-rank single bank, target 100% of equity, execute next-session open.
motivation_and_limitation: Exploratory concentration follow-up informed by already observed V35/V40 results; do not interpret as independent unseen validation and do not change the frozen weight.
